english.title: Drunk whilst entering a sports ground - sporting events

additionalkeywords.additionalkeyword: SPORTING EVENTS CONTROL OF ALCOHOL ETC ACT 1985

english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) were drunk while entering a designated sports ground at a time during the period of a designated sporting event at that ground.
english.legislation: Contrary to section 2(2) and 8 of the Sporting Events (Control of Alcohol etc) Act 1985.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
drunk
while entering
a designated sports ground
during the period of a designated sporting event

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence

DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes: A constable may, at any time during the period of a designated sporting event at any designated sports ground, enter any part of the ground for the purpose of enforcing the provisions of this Act. (SECTION 7(1))

other.powersofarrest: A constable may search a person he has reasonable grounds to suspect is committing or has committed an offence under this act, and may arrest such a person. SECTION 7(2)
other.penalty:
A fine not exceeding level two on the standard scale.

Time limit for prosecutions:
6 months
